versions.text: Criterion: Verify that the system safety program addresses range safety. Standard: The system safety program is responsive to test range safety requirements and official requests for safety analysis information. Method of Compliance: System safety program support for range safety is verified by inspection of system safety process documentation. References: MIL-STD-882 RCC 323 Range Safety Criteria for Unmanned Air Vehicles 14 CFR Section 1309 of Parts 23, 25, 27, 29; and related advisory circulars.
